program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
                  (items (filter (lambda (x) x)
                                 (map (lambda (obj)
                                        (with-bbox obj
                                                   (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                                   (let* ((hh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                                                          (ww (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                                                          (area (* hh ww))
                                                          (n3 (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                                          (= (at g
                                                                                 (first p)
                                                                                 (second p))
                                                                             3))
                                                                        (obj-cells obj))))
                                                     (and
                                                       (<= hh 8)
                                                       (list (+ (* (- n3) 1000000)
                                                                (* area 1000)
                                                                (* r1 30)
                                                                c1)
                                                             obj)))))
                                      objs)))
                  (chosen (second (first (sort-by items first))))
                  (bb (obj-bbox chosen)))
             (crop g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
